elements.description: A multi-step flow: numbered steps, sliding panes, checks on Continue and a success state.

properties.name: steps
properties.description: The steps in order: id, title, content and the check Continue runs

properties.name: values
properties.description: The values of every step

properties.name: step
properties.description: The open step's index

properties.name: onComplete
properties.description: Runs with all values on the last step; return a promise to show "Creating…" until it settles (throw to show an error that can be retried). The signal aborts when the form is removed mid-way

properties.name: submitLabel
properties.description: Label of the last button

properties.name: submittingLabel
properties.description: Label while onComplete runs

properties.name: success
properties.type: ((values: Values, reset: () => void) => unknown) | null | undefined
properties.description: What shows once onComplete is done: a render function, unset for a short "All set", or null to leave the pane empty for the app

properties.name: panes
properties.description: The panes shown: the current one, and one sliding out

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-values-change
events.description: A step changed the values; detail `{ values }`. Cancelable.

events.name: tc-step-change
events.description: Another step opens; detail `{ step: number }`. Cancelable.

events.name: tc-panes-change
events.description: The panes shown or the current step's errors changed (for apps that render the step content themselves); detail `{ panes: StepperPane[] }`.

methods.name: setValues
methods.description: Merges a patch into the values

methods.name: goTo
methods.description: Jumps to a step by id – forward jumps need the current step to pass first

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Back to the start: the first values and step, nothing checked, not done

elements.description:
A label, the control and an inline message that folds in – the control shakes when Continue finds a problem.
Put the control (a tc-stepper-input, tc-stepper-tags …) inside; it stays where you put it, between the label and
the messages.

properties.name: name
properties.description: Matches the key in the step's validate result

properties.name: label
properties.description: The field's label, tied to its control

properties.name: hint
properties.description: A hint under the control: text, or an element (cloned)

properties.name: optional
properties.description: Shows “Optional” after the label

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

elements.description:
A text field wired to its tc-stepper-field – label, message and aria come from there. Put a native <input> inside;
every attribute you give it stays yours.

properties.name: prefixText
properties.description: Fixed text before the value, e.g. "acme.com/"

properties.name: describedby
properties.description: More ids that describe the input, after the field's message or hint

properties.name: controlId
properties.description: The input's id when it isn't in a field

properties.name: controlInvalid
properties.description: Marks the input invalid on its own (the field's verdict wins)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

elements.description:
Entries as chips – add with Enter, comma or by pasting a list, remove with × or Backspace. Defaults to email checks.
Form-associated: the entries are submitted comma-separated under `name`.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The entries added so far

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder while there are no entries – then it reads “Add another”

properties.name: validate
properties.description: Returns a message when an entry can't be added

properties.name: max
properties.description: Largest number of entries

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name for form submission: the entries, comma-separated

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Turns off typing and removing entries

properties.name: required
properties.description: Marks the field as required for assistive tech – checking it is up to the step's validate

properties.name: autocomplete
properties.description: The input's autocomplete – "off" by default, since the entries are usually other people's addresses

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: Entries were added or removed; detail `{ value: string[] }`. Cancelable.

elements.description:
Selectable cards – a ring glides to the chosen one. Arrow keys move, Enter picks and continues. Form-associated: the
chosen value is submitted under `name`.

properties.name: value
properties.description: The chosen option's value; empty when none is chosen

properties.name: options
properties.description: The cards to choose from

properties.name: label
properties.description: Name of the group for screen readers

properties.name: name
properties.description: Name for form submission

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: Turns off choosing

properties.name: required
properties.description: Marks the group as required for assistive tech – checking it is up to the step's validate

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: Another card was chosen; detail `{ value: string }`. Cancelable.

elements.description: A summary of what was entered, each row with an Edit link back to its step.

properties.name: rows
properties.description: The rows: a label, the value entered and the step that sets it

properties.name: editable
properties.description: Shows the Edit links

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-edit
events.description: An Edit link was pressed; detail `{ step: string }` – pass it to the step context's goTo.

elements.description: The success state: a check pops in, a heading and a short line; anything you put inside follows them (actions).

properties.name: description

features.name: light-dark()
features.why: Every colour token is a light / dark pair; without it no colour token resolves.

features.name: Form association (ElementInternals)
features.why: The element's value is submitted with its form, and it takes part in form validation and reset.

features.name: color-mix()
features.why: Tints and washes mixed from the tokens.

features.name: Container size queries
features.why: Components adapt to the width they're given, not the window's.

features.name: inert
features.why: Closed and leaving parts are out of the tab order and hidden from screen readers.

features.name: :has()
features.why: Layout and state that depend on what's inside a part (an icon present, a focused field).

features.name: :is() and :where()
features.why: Every rule is keyed on :where() so the page can override it.

features.name: text-wrap: pretty
features.without: Paragraphs may end on a single short word.

features.name: scrollbar-width
features.without: Scrollbars keep the browser's default width.

features.name: text-wrap: balance
features.without: Titles break where the line fills up instead of into even lines.

features.name: adoptedStyleSheets
features.without: Each element type's CSS goes into one <style> element in <head> instead – it looks and works the same.

features.name: forced-colors media query
features.without: In a forced-colours mode the browser's own adjustments apply, without the components' fixes.

features.name: overscroll-behavior: contain
features.without: Scrolling past the end of a list carries on scrolling the page.
